name: Latch Cord
description: Close a cord of qi round a wrist and latch it so it will not slip.

name: Closing Guard
description: Shut a guard of qi over the chest like a latched door.

name: Shut Sense
description: Feel which of a foe's channels have been shut by a seal.

name: Locked Loop
description: Lock a loop so the foe's struggle cannot slacken it.

name: Hasp Seal
description: Hasp one of a foe's techniques shut with a knot of qi.

name: Cleared Latch
description: Open a hostile latch laid on an ally and lift the sealed binding clear.

name: Locking Fetter
description: Close a fetter that also locks the foe's strongest technique behind it.

name: Shut Net
description: Spread a net of latched cords over a field and shut each foe inside.

name: Sealed Dominion
description: Hold a strong foe in a bond whose every strand is also a seal.

name: Latched Knot
description: streams: Binding + Sealing; tie a seal into the binding so the foe is held and its technique locked in one knot.

name: Spirit Thread
description: Spin a thread of qi finer than sight and tie it to a foe's wrist.

name: Inner Guard
description: Draw a guard of qi close to the chest to shelter the breath.

name: Pulse Feel
description: Feel the pulse of a bond to learn what the bound person intends.

name: Quiet Draw
description: Draw along a quiet tether so the steps make no sound.

name: Mind Tether
description: Tie a tether on a foe's attention so the foe's eyes follow the binder's hand.

name: Spirit Knot
description: Knot the thread of a foe's focus so the foe's next technique stalls.

name: Thread Mending
description: Mend a thread of spirit torn by a hostile binding until the ally is whole.

name: Shared Cord
description: Run a bridging line between two allies so the weaker draws on the stronger's will.

name: Spirit Net
description: Cast a net of fine threads that closes on each foe's body and attention together.

name: Deep Fetter
description: Close a fetter that reaches below the skin and holds the foe from within.

name: Spirit Dominion
description: Hold a powerful foe by a bond that runs through body and spirit alike.

name: Threaded Spirit
description: streams: Binding + Soul; thread one bond through body and spirit so the foe cannot act or flee and feels each tug.

name: Ruled Cord
description: Cast a cord straight and exact as a ruled line and close it on a foe's arm.

name: Law Guard
description: Hold a guard of qi square and even so it turns a blow along a fixed line.

name: Rule Sense
description: Read the terms of a bond by feeling its straight and crooked turns.

name: Fixed Tie
description: Fix a tie to a set point so the foe can only move along the line.

name: Decree Knot
description: Tie a knot that cancels the order behind a foe's coming technique.

name: Order Lend
description: Lend a bound ally the user's own discipline so the ally moves in steady order.

name: Strict Unpicking
description: Unpick a hostile binding along its own rule until the ally moves free.

name: Statute Net
description: Cast a net laid out by rule that closes square on every foe it covers.

name: Decreed Fetters
description: Fetter a strong foe to a decree that tightens whenever the foe breaks its terms.

name: Binding Edict
description: Pronounce an edict through a bond that holds a mighty foe under its terms.

name: Law Chain
description: streams: Binding + Order; lay a chain set by rule round a foe so every link holds as law holds.
